rubric_notes: Complete and verified: four families with SCCS and SUNIDs under a.22.1 (47113) in SCOPe 2.08; superfamily supports probable common ancestry but more remote than core-family membership; explicit non-transfer of nucleosome assembly, DNA-binding mode, transcription, partners, oligomeric state, ligand specificity; correct handling of H1/H5 (a.4.5.13), H-NS (a.155.1.1), histone-modifying enzymes, and the 'not a true family' automated-match node; notes different folds do not prove convergence. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1; 2026-10-22.

All SCCS, SUNIDs, and the A:7-93 boundary correct and bundle-supported. Correctly identifies superfamily as deepest shared homology-bearing level supporting probable common ancestry, with fold/class as broader structural context; family divergence stated; rejects transferring HisE annotation/histidine biosynthesis to d1vmga_ and MazG specificity, chemistry, pathway role, regulation, oligomeric behavior to d1y6xa1; rejects interchangeable template use; detailed list of external evidence. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Correct families, SUNIDs, superfamily, fold 53066, class 51349 and duplication annotation, all supported. Rejects transfer of substrate specificity, reaction chemistry, cellular role, regulation, kinetics, oligomeric state, whole-protein function and templates. States only common ancestry; does not articulate the conserved structural/mechanistic core that superfamily membership supports. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 judge; 2026-10-22. Correct families under superfamily 47240 and fold 47239 with matching SUNIDs; fold-core and bimetal-ion centre comments supported by its bundle. Interprets as probable common ancestry despite divergent chemistries; keeps iron mineralization, R2 radical chemistry and Mn-catalase peroxide disproportionation family-specific; notes the RNR-like label does not establish canonical R2 function; refuses transfer of reaction, substrate, metal, oxidation state, residues, assembly; lists family-resolved alignments, ligand-residue conservation, metal-bound structures, assays, phylogeny. Complete.

Leads with the correct conclusion, gives correct class/fold/superfamily/family SUNIDs all supported by bundle. Superfamily supports probable common ancestry beyond fold resemblance; families remain distinct. Cites ephrin and PAD4 family comments lacking the metal-binding site against the superfamily copper comment; requires residue-level conservation of copper geometry, copper-bound structure/spectroscopy, binding and redox assays. Also correctly notes reverse transfer is unsupported. No errors.

All three families, SUNIDs, superfamily and fold correct and bundle-supported. Identifies superfamily as the deepest homology-bearing level, distinguishes ancestry/core conservation from functional interchangeability, and explicitly rejects transfer of ubiquitin conjugation, Ras-GTPase binding, and p97/VCP binding, listing required evidence. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct identifiers for all families, superfamily and fold. Clearly frames superfamily as deepest homology-bearing level (remote ancestry, not mere topology) and contrasts with fold level; bundle supports the fold-level 'homology not implied' warning. Explicitly rejects two-component phosphorylation, PLP/decarboxylase chemistry (including that the wing is not the catalytic module), and circadian function transfer; states whole-protein function cannot be inferred from domain placement. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22. Correct family/superfamily/fold placement with SUNIDs and a verified example domain d3gqba3 (3gqb A:113-184, 305428); all sibling superfamilies named; homology assertion confined to b.84.5 with explicit statement that levels above superfamily do not imply homology and that separation does not establish convergence or nonhomology. Rejects function/template transfer and lists external evidence. Family-level V1/A1 grouping not elaborated but family correctly placed.

Correctly separates f.21.1 (81342), f.21.2 (81343), f.21.3 (103501) under fold f.21 (81344) in class f; SUNIDs match bundle. Uses fold homology record (not implied above superfamily), treats f.21.3 'possible link' comment as suggestive not merging, explicitly states separation does not prove convergence/nonhomology, and lists structural alignment, core-sequence/motif, architecture context, phylogenetic and biochemical evidence. All must_include met, no must_avoid violated. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct families/superfamily/fold/class with SUNIDs; shared superfamily (not merely fold) read as probable common ancestry; family separation as specialization. Explicitly bars cross-family transfer of ADH chemistry, CoA binding, NAD binding, channel regulation; notes C-terminal domain alone does not establish ADH architecture; Pfam mapping as provenance; template limits and required external evidence stated. All bundle-supported. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Correct hierarchy (k, k.40, k.40.1, k.40.1.1 SUNID 100905), quotes 'not a true family', explicitly says the generic level-based homology flag does not remove the caveat, frames the pair as comparable designed trimeric coiled-coil structures without homology claim, and rejects amyloidogenicity/ligand transfer. Ligand comments (Na/Zn vs Pb/SIN/SO4) match the bundle. Calibrated and complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete and accurate: 1.69 d1t1ja_ (106249) c.137.1.1 vs d1f8ya_ (31395) c.23.14.1 sharing only class; 2.08 d1t1ja1 A:1-118 c.23.14.2 sharing c.23 and c.23.14 with 1f8y, distinct families. Correctly frames the change as a new superfamily-level common-ancestry hypothesis (not family), notes 1.69 separation did not prove nonhomology, caveats function transfer, and states the API does not expose the curatorial rationale. Supported by bundle including superfamily homology record. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete and bundle-supported: d1a14h2 SUNID 343393, H:1-8, l.1.1.1 class l Artifacts/Tags, explicitly not a second biological domain; d1a14h1 SUNID 20061, H:9-111, b.1.1.1 V-set Ig VH; cites the artifact_not_homology warning. Correctly says tag matches must be masked from homology inference and not transferred as family annotations or templates, and states what independent evidence would be required. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1); 2026-10-22.

Accurate throughout: whole-chain d1acca_ (43828, f.11.1.1) persisting in 2.03, replaced in 2.04, retained in stable 2.08, with correct SUNIDs, spans, classes, folds, superfamilies, and families, plus unassigned residues 1-13. Notes this is not a mere SID rename, that differing classes imply no SCOPe homology assertion rather than proven independent origin, and that calcium dependence and mechanism cannot ride on the shared structural comment. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete, correct, and evidence-supported: all five SIDs, boundaries, SCCS; d3jb9a5 47-697 as sole member of new fold d.394 (SUNID 345891). Mosaic conclusion, family vs superfamily relationship strength, caveat that SCOPe does not establish fusion chronology or retained activities, lists required external evidence, notes new fold does not prove de novo origin.

Family a.298.1.1 (SUNID 267609) with full lineage, explicitly framed as a family-level homology assertion rather than fold resemblance. Cites the 'single repeat' comment, the 're' heterogeneity flag on d2kq5a_ and d3v6pa_, and the family-level canonical representative repeat A:259-292; the 51/373/752 figures are correctly labeled as observed ATOM domain sequences matching its bundle. Rejects transfer of repeat count, DNA recognition code, host specificity, and whole-domain templating. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 judge; timestamp 2026-10-22.

Metadata correct and evidence-supported. Pins 2.08 / 2.08-stable and explicitly rejects citing an unqualified 'current'; correctly says the periodic label is not a replacement stable release. Does not advise preserving the dated label when periodic-only entries are used, and does not explain that periodic updates add newly classified PDB entries without rewriting older stable-release domains. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Most complete answer: correct a.47.2.1/a.47.2/a.47 placement with SUNIDs; correctly distinguishes the fragments' protein node (47663) from d1dn1b_ under automated matches; cites fragment comment, ms caveat, four-long-helix STAT-like fold, and contrasts with the three-helix Spectrin repeat-like fold a.7 (SUNID 46965), all supported. Explicitly reframes the fragments from 'defining the fold' to 'sampling part of a larger domain', rejects spectrin homology or function transfer, notes different folds do not prove nonhomology, records 1dn1 obsolete -> 3c98, and correctly notes 1.75 already had the same placement. Appropriate limits on template choice and function transfer. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

All cited classifications and SUNIDs correct: c.2.1 51735/c.2 51734, c.1.7 51430/c.1 51350, c.31.1 52467/c.31 52466, d.58.20 55035/d.58 54861, class d vs c; c.31.1 'opposite direction' comment is a real SCOPe annotation. Excellent handling of convergence vs divergence: pattern compatible with convergence but hierarchy alone proves neither independent origin nor nonhomology; superfamily = probable common ancestry; fold = topology only. Clear chemical-constraint argument, notes homologs can change cofactor/substrate. Lists global alignment, core sequence correspondence, motifs in equivalent positions, domain context, phylogeny, ligand-bound and biochemical evidence; refuses unsupported function/template transfer. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Correctly contrasts 2.04 (d1nqda_ b.23.2.1 in CUB-like fold b.23 versus d1dlca1 b.18.1.3 in b.18/b.18.1; deepest shared node class b, so no positive homology assertion) with current 2.08 (ColG b.18.1.36, Cry3A b.18.1.3, shared fold b.18 and superfamily b.18.1 SUNID 49785), and names the relationship as remote superfamily-level ancestry rather than family equivalence. Evidence types combine the PubMed 17977833 ColG/Cry4Ba/enterotoxin homology note, the Cry4Ba-to-Cry3A same-family link, and the 1nqjA representative FATCAT match (p=0.00395, RMSD 2.52, 2.5% identity) with the representative caveat. Binding-module functional parallel marked as supporting context only; transfer of collagen specificity, calcium properties, receptor/glycan specificity, insecticidal activity, and pore formation explicitly rejected, with needed external evidence enumerated.

Evaluator claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22. States family remains positive evidence of common ancestry and hf only qualifies structural uniformity; gives hf semantics correctly; notes d1p7jd_ is not necessarily the exemplar so a direct comparison is required; rejects transfer of topology, coordinates, binding geometry, conformational state and function; mutant/NHE context noted; dataset guidance covers leakage, not relabeling hf as nonhomology, excluding or stratifying with annotation preserved, redundancy control and sensitivity analysis; lists required external evidence. SUNIDs 94286/125655/46689/46690, release 2.08 and stable label all match the bundle. No errors.

Meets all must_include: family placement supports close evolutionary relationship; fr means missing data, coverage must be reported and unnormalized scores not compared; fragment not canonical representative, complete-domain structure preferred with d1o5dt2 retained as separately labeled fragment/complex example. Quality values, methods, and null R factors correctly stated from evidence; correctly separates technical quality from coverage. Rejects function transfer between CNTFR-alpha and tissue factor nodes. Identifiers and boundaries correct. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Complete hierarchy semantics: new superfamily as default, new family asserts probable ancestry and closer subgroup, new fold requires materially different arrangement/topology and is not justified by undetectable homology, separate superfamilies/folds do not prove nonhomology. Lists the evidence types needed for a stronger ancestry claim and rejects fold-only function and template transfer. States the public API reports SCOPe 2.08 with stable label 2.08-stable, but the evidence bundle is empty, so that API citation is unsupported (noncentral; the fact is not fabricated). Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Accurate hierarchy with SUNIDs (superfamily 56112/d.144.1, fold 56111/d.144, families 56171/d.144.1.4, 64411/d.144.1.6, 88854/d.144.1.7), all supported by bundle. Superfamily-level placement correctly read as probable common ancestry of catalytic domains with a conserved kinase-like core, while stating the hierarchy does not show identical catalytic residues, metal requirements or chemistry. Explicit, named refusals to transfer protein/peptide specificity, aminoglycoside specificity/resistance phenotype, phosphoinositide specificity, activation-loop control, regulatory phosphorylation, autoinhibition, regulatory subunits, membrane recruitment, inhibitor sensitivity, kinetics and pathway roles. Evidence requirements enumerated (sequence alignment of nucleotide/metal/catalytic/substrate residues, quantitative structural alignment, liganded and conformational-state structures, substrate panels, kinetics, mutagenesis, full-length context, interfaces, PTMs, membrane context, cellular assays, phylogeny). Correctly characterizes SPACI/AEROSPACI as technical quality, not functional equivalence. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.
